name: gdrive-telegram-bot
description: Google Drive to Telegram bot: downloads files your Google account can access and re-uploads them losslessly, in course order.

ALLOWED_USER_IDS.description: Comma-separated Telegram numeric user ids allowed to use the bot. Do not leave empty in production.

GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth refresh token — grants read-only access to your Drive

GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON.description: Alternative to OAuth: paste the whole service-account key JSON on one line

FOLDER_ORDER.description: deep = whole Module 1 then Module 2; breadth = level by level

CONCURRENT_DOWNLOADS.description: Parallel transfers (1 is safest on small dynos)

JOBS_DB.description: Resume ledger path (inside the mounted volume on Render)
